stories.h: Judges urge dropping gravest Netanyahu corruption case
stories.s: Jerusalem judges told the attorney general Case 4000 has little chance of conviction, urged rethinking Case 2000 and a negotiated deal in Case 1000; prosecutors say they will weigh it.

stories.h: Eisenkot clinches first coalition deal, with Liberman's party
stories.s: Yashar and Yisrael Beytenu announced a coalition agreement; Liberman predicts a government by end of next week, though the Democrats froze talks and UTJ still awaits rabbinic approval.

stories.h: Trump says Iran war funded only through January
stories.s: Trump's remark implies a narrow window for any renewed US-Israeli offensive; he says his aims, unlike Israel's, are limited to stopping an Iranian bomb. Two tankers hit mines near Hormuz Wednesday.

stories.h: Katz claims Iran is developing chemical weapons
stories.s: The caretaker defense minister gave no details on the alleged program, which Tehran calls fraudulent, and said Israel will keep troops in buffer zones in Lebanon, Gaza and Syria.

stories.h: Knesset panel advances repeal of Karhi's media law
stories.s: A special committee sent the bill undoing Netanyahu's government's July broadcasting overhaul to its first plenum reading, part of the Eisenkot bloc's push to reverse contested laws.
